title: feat(p4closed): whether cov4>0 is equivalent to selector P
science: Second refutation of the #6494 selector, failing in the OPPOSITE direction from #6503: at |S|=4, P is sufficient but not necessary (N_P=14, N_pos=24, N_both=14; ten P-false maps still fill, lex-first (0,0,1,0,0) with cov4=52). Taken with #6494 and #6503 this pins P as exactly cov>0 only at k=2, over-permissive at k=1 and over-restrictive at k=4.
verdict_pair: reverse=none face=none (f_cut selector-equivalence census; no (reverse,face) pair stated)
